interactables.text: The [Director], Wexler, scribbles in a leather notebook. 'Missing bird + weeping star + locked mansion = [Emmy bait].' He doesn't look up.
The [Sound Guy]'s badge reads '[D. Marsh].' He is very busy re-coiling a cable that was already coiled. 'Nice cat,' he says, half an octave too high.
The mixing board hums, still powered on long after wrap. An [Audio Cable] leaves the back panel and vanishes [into the wall].
A session log wedged behind the podium: 'TAKE 12 - bird. TAKE 23 - bird. TAKE 47 - [RUINED. BIRD. AGAIN.]' The handwriting gets angrier with every page. The last page has torn through.
The Director's shot list for today. Items include: 'Rudebeak reaction shot - [CANCELLED].' Next to it, in red pen: '[BETTER WITHOUT HIM?]'

localDeductionSentence: Wexler smells an Emmy - meanwhile [Sound Guy] left his mixer humming, an [Audio Cable] runs into the wall, and the session log is one long scream about [Ruined Takes].
